pieces.Text: As a full action, you can conjure augmenting plates of armor from planar energies, enhancing your own armor. When using this ability, you must expend a mystic spell slot of 1st level or higher, and the armor lasts a number of rounds equal to 1 + the level of the spell slot expended. The benefits you gain from your planar armor are: * +1 enhancement bonus to your AC. * +2 resistance bonus to saving throws. * Resistance equal to twice the expended spell slot's spell level against one energy type of your choice. * A burrow speed of 20 feet, fly speed of 30 feet (perfect maneuverability), or swim speed of 30 feet (your choice).
